title: Barricade the target stands against
description: A 1-inch-wide cover piece lies between the models and touches the target's base.
basis: Cover conditions p. 38 (confirmed wording); readings U4, U15, U77, U78
ruling: The 0.75" barricade hides the target's legs and body points; its head shows over the top, so sight is Partial. The barricade is at least 1/2" high, touches the target, is as wide as its base and hides part of it, so it gives cover. (Before L2: Full 4/4 with cover.)
